description: 平成30年版大分県統計年鑑 10電気、ガスおよび水道 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. 平成30年大分県統計年鑑の電気、ガス及び水道のデータです。. Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are 統計. It offers 6 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2020-08-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
